# EDA2 public catalogue

Download `identifications_test_v5_starlink_3_min_final_export.csv` from <https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.15089853> and place it in this directory.

Expected MD5: `9f609cc39ef2b8aee6e3f624bad40481`.

The catalogue is an external input used by the literature comparison and orbital-state re-analysis in Chapter 5.
